Box 156 Woodville, Ohio 43469 P: 419.849.3031 | F: 419.849.3045 www.village ofwoodville.com No person, firm or corporation shall locate, erect, construct, reconstruct, enlarge or structurally alter any building, accessory building, utility building or structure within the Village or change the use of the building or land without having first obtained a zoning permit. If the zoning permit is issued for the purpose of constructing a new building, or structure and such construction is not begun within a six - month period, then the zoning permit shall be null and void. The permit may be valid for six months after the date of issuance or until completion of the project within one year after such date.
